Name: Fluffy
Effect: Reduce by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokémon by All Physical Moves. Increase by 2 the Damage dealt to this Pokémon by Fire-Type Moves.
Description: This Pokémon's fur is so fluffy you could die. So soft and snuggly that it invites you to hug it. Hand-wash only, tumble dry with no heat, do not iron.
